notes:
Describes using money, time, energy, or other resources carelessly and without value. Always carries a strongly negative nuance — the spending is seen as wasteful and irresponsible.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{浪費|ろうひ}する: waste money
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{浪費|ろうひ}する: waste time
- ⟦{浪費|ろうひ}→浪費：09204_rouhi⟧{癖|ぐせ}: habit of wasteful spending
- ⟦{浪費|ろうひ}→浪費：09204_rouhi⟧⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧: spendthrift; big spender
- ⟦{資源|しげん}→資源：03167_shigen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{浪費|ろうひ}する: waste resources

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無駄遣|むだづか}い→無駄遣い：07310_mudazukai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to waste (money) — a more colloquial term, often used for everyday overspending
- ⟦{節約|せつやく}する→節約する：25226_setsuyakusuru⟧: to economize — the antonym, meaning to save or cut back
- ⟦{消費|しょうひ}する→消費する：25230_shouhisuru⟧: to consume — neutral term for using up resources, without the negative nuance of wastefulness
- ⟦{散財|さんざい}→散財：09233_sanzai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to splurge — implies spending a lot of money, but can be used either negatively or self-deprecatingly
